verses.original: αἱ γυναῖκες Ὁμοίως ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ἵνα καὶ εἴ τινες ἀπειθοῦσιν τῷ λόγῳ κερδηθήσονται ἄνευ λόγου διὰ τῆς ἀναστροφῆς τῶν γυναικῶν
verses.transliteration: hai gynaikes Homoiōs hypotassomenai tois idiois andrasin hina kai ei tines apeithousin tō logō kerdēthēsontai aneu logou dia tēs anastrophēs tōn gynaikōn
verses.literal: - Wives in the same way submit yourselves to [your] - husbands so that even if [they] refuse to believe the word they will be won over without words by the behavior of [their] wives

verses.original: ἐποπτεύσαντες τὴν ὑμῶν ἐν ἁγνὴν φόβῳ ἀναστροφὴν
verses.transliteration: epopteusantes tēn hymōn en hagnēn phobō anastrophēn
verses.literal: when they see - your vvv pure [and] reverent demeanor

verses.original: ὧν οὐχ ἔστω ὁ ἔξωθεν κόσμος ἐμπλοκῆς τριχῶν καὶ περιθέσεως χρυσίων ἢ ἐνδύσεως ἱματίων
verses.transliteration: hōn ouch estō ho exōthen kosmos emplokēs trichōn kai peritheseōs chrysiōn ē endyseōs himatiōn
verses.literal: [Your beauty] {should} not come [from] outward adornment [such as] braided hair or - gold [jewelry] or - fine clothes

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ κρυπτὸς ἄνθρωπος τῆς καρδίας ἐν τῷ ἀφθάρτῳ τοῦ πραέως καὶ ἡσυχίου πνεύματος ὅ ἐστιν πολυτελές τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐνώπιον
verses.transliteration: all’ ho kryptos anthrōpos tēs kardias en tō aphthartō tou praeōs kai hēsychiou pneumatos ho estin polyteles tou Theou enōpion
verses.literal: but from the inner disposition of [your] heart - the unfading [ beauty ] of a gentle and quiet spirit which is precious - in God’s sight

verses.original: γάρ Οὕτως αἱ ἅγιαι γυναῖκες ποτε καὶ ἐκόσμουν ἑαυτάς αἱ ἐλπίζουσαι εἰς Θεὸν ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν
verses.transliteration: gar Houtōs hai hagiai gynaikes pote kai ekosmoun heautas hai elpizousai eis Theon hypotassomenai tois idiois andrasin
verses.literal: For this is how the holy women of the past - adorned themselves - They put their hope in God [and] were submissive to [their] husbands

verses.original: ὡς Σάρρα ὑπήκουσεν τῷ Ἀβραάμ καλοῦσα αὐτὸν κύριον ἐγενήθητε ἧς τέκνα ἀγαθοποιοῦσαι καὶ μὴ φοβούμεναι μηδεμίαν πτόησιν
verses.transliteration: hōs Sarra hypēkousen tō Abraam kalousa auton kyrion egenēthēte hēs tekna agathopoiousai kai mē phoboumenai mēdemian ptoēsin
verses.literal: just as Sarah obeyed - Abraham [and] called him lord [And] you are [her] children if you do what is right and refuse to give way . . . to fear

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ὁμοίως συνοικοῦντες ἀπονέμοντες τῷ γυναικείῳ κατὰ γνῶσιν ὡς ἀσθενεστέρῳ σκεύει καὶ τιμήν ὡς συνκληρονόμοις χάριτος ζωῆς εἰς ὑμῶν τὰς προσευχὰς τὸ μὴ ἐνκόπτεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres homoiōs synoikountes aponemontes tō gynaikeiō kata gnōsin hōs asthenesterō skeuei kai timēn hōs synklēronomois charitos zōēs eis hymōn tas proseuchas to mē enkoptesthai
verses.literal: - Husbands in the same way treat . . . [your] wives {with} consideration as a delicate vessel and {with} honor as fellow heirs of [the] gracious gift of life so that your - prayers - vvv will not be hindered

verses.original: δὲ Τὸ τέλος πάντες ὁμόφρονες συμπαθεῖς φιλάδελφοι εὔσπλαγχνοι ταπεινόφρονες
verses.transliteration: de To telos pantes homophrones sympatheis philadelphoi eusplanchnoi tapeinophrones
verses.literal: vvv vvv Finally all [of you] [be] like-minded [and] sympathetic love as brothers [be] tenderhearted [and] humble

verses.original: μὴ ἀποδιδόντες κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἢ λοιδορίαν ἀντὶ λοιδορίας δὲ τοὐναντίον εὐλογοῦντες ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο ἐκλήθητε ἵνα κληρονομήσητε εὐλογίαν
verses.transliteration: mē apodidontes kakon anti kakou ē loidorian anti loidorias de tounantion eulogountes hoti eis touto eklēthēte hina klēronomēsēte eulogian
verses.literal: vvv Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult but . . . with blessing because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing

verses.original: γὰρ Ὁ θέλων ἀγαπᾶν ζωὴν καὶ ἰδεῖν ἀγαθὰς ἡμέρας παυσάτω τὴν γλῶσσαν ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ χείλη μὴ τοῦ δόλον λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: gar Ho thelōn agapan zōēn kai idein agathas hēmeras pausatō tēn glōssan apo kakou kai cheilē mē tou dolon lalēsai
verses.literal: For Whoever would love life and see good days must keep [his] tongue from evil and [his] lips [from] - deceitful speech

verses.original: δὲ ἐκκλινάτω ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποιησάτω ἀγαθόν ζητησάτω εἰρήνην καὶ διωξάτω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: de ekklinatō apo kakou kai poiēsatō agathon zētēsatō eirēnēn kai diōxatō autēn
verses.literal: - He must turn from evil and do good he must seek peace and pursue it

verses.original: ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ αὐτοῦ ὦτα εἰς αὐτῶν δέησιν δὲ πρόσωπον Κυρίου ἐπὶ ποιοῦντας κακά
verses.transliteration: hoti ophthalmoi Kyriou epi dikaious kai autou ōta eis autōn deēsin de prosōpon Kyriou epi poiountas kaka
verses.literal: For [the] eyes of [the] Lord [are] on [the] righteous and His ears are inclined to their prayer But [the] face of [the] Lord [is] against those who do evil

verses.original: Καὶ τίς ὁ κακώσων ὑμᾶς ἐὰν γένησθε ζηλωταὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai tis ho kakōsōn hymas ean genēsthe zēlōtai tou agathou
verses.literal: - Who - can harm you if you are zealous for what [is] good

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ καὶ εἰ πάσχοιτε διὰ δικαιοσύνην μακάριοι δὲ μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτῶν Τὸν φόβον μηδὲ ταραχθῆτε
verses.transliteration: All’ kai ei paschoite dia dikaiosynēn makarioi de mē phobēthēte autōn Ton phobon mēde tarachthēte
verses.literal: But even if you should suffer for what is right [you are] blessed - vvv Do not fear what - they fear vvv do not be shaken

verses.original: δὲ ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις ἁγιάσατε τὸν Χριστὸν Κύριον ἀεὶ ἕτοιμοι πρὸς ἀπολογίαν παντὶ τῷ αἰτοῦντι ὑμᾶς λόγον περὶ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἐν ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ μετὰ πραΰτητος καὶ φόβου
verses.transliteration: de en hymōn tais kardiais hagiasate ton Christon Kyrion aei hetoimoi pros apologian panti tō aitounti hymas logon peri tēs elpidos en hymin alla meta prautētos kai phobou
verses.literal: But in your - hearts sanctify - Christ [as] Lord Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope [that is] in you But [respond] with gentleness and respect

verses.original: ἔχοντες ἀγαθήν συνείδησιν ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλεῖσθε οἱ ἐπηρεάζοντες καταισχυνθῶσιν ὑμῶν ἀγαθὴν τὴν ἀναστροφήν ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: echontes agathēn syneidēsin hina en hō katalaleisthe hoi epēreazontes kataischynthōsin hymōn agathēn tēn anastrophēn en Christō
verses.literal: keeping a clear conscience so that vvv vvv those who slander you . . . . . . may be put to shame by your good - behavior in Christ

verses.original: γὰρ κρεῖττον εἰ θέλοι τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ θέλημα πάσχειν ἀγαθοποιοῦντας ἢ κακοποιοῦντας
verses.transliteration: gar kreitton ei theloi tou Theou to thelēma paschein agathopoiountas ē kakopoiountas
verses.literal: For [it is] better if [it is] - God’s - will to suffer [for] doing good than for doing evil

verses.original: ὅτι Χριστὸς καὶ ἔπαθεν περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἅπαξ δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων ἵνα προσαγάγῃ ὑμᾶς τῷ Θεῷ μὲν θανατωθεὶς σαρκὶ δὲ ζωοποιηθεὶς πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: hoti Christos kai epathen peri hamartiōn hapax dikaios hyper adikōn hina prosagagē hymas tō Theō men thanatōtheis sarki de zōopoiētheis pneumati
verses.literal: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all [the] righteous for [the] unrighteous to bring you - to God - He was put to death in [the] body but made alive in [the] Spirit

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ πορευθεὶς ἐκήρυξεν τοῖς πνεύμασιν ἐν φυλακῇ
verses.transliteration: en hō kai poreutheis ekēryxen tois pneumasin en phylakē
verses.literal: in whom vvv He also went [and] preached to the spirits in prison

verses.original: ἀπειθήσασίν ποτε ὅτε Θεοῦ ἀπεξεδέχετο ἡ μακροθυμία τοῦ ἐν ἡμέραις Νῶε κιβωτοῦ κατασκευαζομένης εἰς ἣν ὀλίγοι τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ὀκτὼ ψυχαί διεσώθησαν δι’ ὕδατος
verses.transliteration: apeithēsasin pote hote Theou apexedecheto hē makrothymia tou en hēmerais Nōe kibōtou kataskeuazomenēs eis hēn oligoi tout’ estin oktō psychai diesōthēsan di’ hydatos
verses.literal: who disobeyed long ago when God waited - patiently - in [the] days of Noah [while the] ark was being built In [the ark] a few [people] [only] . . . eight souls were saved through water

verses.original: καὶ ὃ ἀντίτυπον βάπτισμα νῦν σῴζει ὑμᾶς οὐ ἀπόθεσις ῥύπου σαρκὸς ἀλλὰ ἐπερώτημα ἀγαθῆς συνειδήσεως εἰς Θεόν δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ho antitypon baptisma nyn sōzei hymas ou apothesis rhypou sarkos alla eperōtēma agathēs syneidēseōs eis Theon di’ anastaseōs Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: And [this water] symbolizes [the] baptism [that] now saves you {also} not the removal of dirt from the body but [the] pledge of a clear conscience toward God through [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὅς πορευθεὶς εἰς οὐρανόν ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀγγέλων καὶ ἐξουσιῶν καὶ δυνάμεων ὑποταγέντων αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hos poreutheis eis ouranon estin en dexia tou Theou angelōn kai exousiōn kai dynameōn hypotagentōn autō
verses.literal: who has gone into heaven [and] is at [the] right hand - of God [with] angels - authorities and powers subject to Him
